about: The white label. Set by the installer for a company, never by a visitor or a user. The service's name in /health and /capabilities comes from here; the built-on mark stays whatever the name. vocabulary is chronos (quest, titan, promethean, offspring, brain, loom) or plain (task, planner, worker, helper, model); left out, it is plain. avatar is the face in the dock: kind face (Chronos's face; frames is a folder the service serves with the same eight file names, or null for her own; tint is null, accent or a colour) or kind monogram (the logo or the monogram). docs/ui.md says how.
name: Chronos Lite
